name: jev-openrouter-decisions-endpoint
description: Update: canonical OpenRouter model id is 'typesafe/jev-1.13' (bare 'jev-latest' also resolves); official SDK surface openrouter.alpha.decisions.create({decisionsRequest}); weighted avg input $0.04185/Mtok, output $0. TypeSafe-reported benchmarks (via LangChain blog 2026-09-17): up to 200x faster / 400x cheaper than comparable LLMs on classification; released ~2026-09-17, API is alpha. LangChain ships langchain-typesafe middleware: ModelRouterMiddleware (Jev picks fast/powerful model per turn) and AutoModeMiddleware (Jev gates risky tool calls pre-execution).

name: judgment-nu-script-vehicle
description: .fabro/scripts/judgment.nu (ADR-0022 decision 11) is the shared session-side Jev caller: nu judgment.nu --request req.json|--stdin --log-file OUTSIDE-REPO.jsonl --skill/--phase/--subject provenance; prints one JSON record {answers,model,latency_ms,cost_usd,status,degraded,error}; fail-open on EVERY path (missing OPENROUTER_API_KEY, bad JSON, timeout, 5xx) with exit 0. Nu 0.115 gotchas hit while building: (1) from json is LENIENT on bare text - returns the string instead of erroring, validate (req | describe) starts-with 'record' before cell-path access; (2) try {} blocks reject multiline flag layouts for http post - keep the call one line; (3) kebab-case flags map to snake_case vars ($max_time), $max-time is a parse error; (4) 'nu script.nu' does NOT bridge process stdin into $in - read 'open --raw /dev/stdin'; (5) save --append writes verbatim - append "\n" yourself for JSONL.
